scope: H1 reviewed lighting group/scene expansion across shared producers, exact raw brightness, partial receipts, explicit internal-only grants, and updated room-search contracts; live home verification and H2-H6 remain incomplete
dependency_limit: Existing runtime virtualenv used read-only with bytecode writes disabled; dependencies still differ from CI pins. Tool installs confined to yo cache.

suite.closed_failure_reason: Four tests still required cross-room fallback despite the current refusal contract. Replacements assert None, exactly one query and the requested area filter; runtime fallback was not restored.

proven: Reviewed lighting scenes accept only explicit on/off, Kelvin and raw 0-255 brightness; sensitive targets, scripts, nested scenes, unknown parameters, templates and contradictory states are rejected
HA-state groups require current exact membership; explicitly reviewed bridge copies can expand even when HA does not expose members, without ever calling the bridge group service
Expansion checks all leaves before the first send; missing grants, unsupported operations, selected ranges, capabilities and unavailable members produce zero sends
Up to eight group levels, 128 leaves and 512 references; cycles/conflicting overlap fail and identical repeated leaf intents execute once
Every intermediate/leaf retains explicit operation/range limits; internal-only grants do not create direct voice or dashboard controls
Sorted shared entity lanes serialize overlapping composite and direct actions; duplicate actor/request identity shares the original task/receipt and a different body conflicts
Current selection, pinned definition, membership observations and fresh leaf capabilities are rechecked before each send
Mid-sequence revocation, definition/membership change, rejection, transport exception or unconfirmed state produces partial uncertainty without a retry
Composite receipts retain exact leaf intents and confirmed/failed/uncertain/not_executed states; frontend displays partial effect counts
Raw brightness values 13,20,64,179,255 survive exact transport and confirmation, with mutually exclusive raw/percentage inputs and unrounded selected-range enforcement
Authenticated HTTP, both voice router modes, dispatcher, persistent routines and due/arrival reminder delivery use the same boundary
Reminder occurrence claim prevents replay of a partial scene after restart; routines preserve scene and raw brightness definitions in storage
Private review requires explicit boolean indirect-effect verification in addition to live verification; failed/missing/string verification cannot retain an old grant
Shared semantic gate rejects past, negated and deferred scene speech; exact selected scene aliases do not use vector target guessing
Compiled artifact outside checkout imports/expands the new pure contracts and retains raw brightness without source .py files
limits: Synthetic transcribed text, HA effects and browser data; no real home action, recording or physical-device result was tested
Review flags are operator declarations requiring H0/H6 evidence; they do not automatically detect every external HA/MQTT/binding/adaptive-lighting configuration change
Bridge reviewed_copy is a fixed selected definition, not automatic MQTT membership synchronization; external changes require reviewing that copy
Scene values come from the reviewed copy; mutable HA scene services and their arbitrary side effects are never invoked
HA observations do not prove physical sensing; Kelvin/brightness quantization and hardware timing still require release validation
Actions are sequential and have no physical rollback or atomicity relative to other HA clients
Detailed leaf receipts remain process-local; scheduled jobs persist the root claim/status and do not replay uncertain occurrences
No relational schema migration; new JSON operation/parameter values still require runtime plus compatible data restoration during rollback
H0 live evidence and legacy-memory treatment, H2-H6 and deployment remain incomplete
